board.openingPolicy: blocked tiles open through chapter objectives; retain at least 8 empty tiles after initial rewards
board.shortScreenMode: smaller cells plus tap-to-merge; never hide last row

rules.chargeRecovery: one token each rechargeSeconds/capacity seconds, fractional progress persists
rules.unlockGrant: Persistent locked board token -> requirements complete -> explicit unlock in the same cell. No automatic inbox G4 grant.

growth.origin: new branch proposal; do not inherit V51 curve 200+120*(level-1)
growth.tutorial: 十份固定委托对应新手 1–10 级，每份交付后进入下一阶段；数值为本分支验收配置，不冒充原作内部奖励。

chapters.name: 重开工作室
chapters.plot: 前搭档卷走样衣；完成邻居的开业订单，找回第一位造型买手。

chapters.name: 街区上新
chapters.plot: 原料商临时涨价；用通勤套装订单证明自己的供应能力。

chapters.name: 第一位品牌买手
chapters.plot: 对手买通博主嘲笑你的配饰；完成买手审查订单，争取橱窗位置。

chapters.name: 被调包的秀场
chapters.plot: 秀场礼服临时被调包；从客户订单和材料线索找出泄密者。

chapters.name: 时尚街区首秀
chapters.plot: 用独立设计系列赢回主场；完整造型揭晓供应链背后的利益关系。

tutorial.text: 面试可以紧张，白T不能皱。
第一次见买手，我想穿得像有备而来。
老板让我气场两米，我先从裤子开始。
上衣和裤子都齐了，勇气我自己搭。
tutorial.unlockHint: 造型台条件达成，在棋盘点击锁定生产器启用。

tutorial.text: 开店可以熬夜，发型不能替我承认。
今天见前搭档，状态必须像已经翻篇。
买手说我没记忆点，这顶帽子应该有。
tutorial.unlockHint: 制鞋台条件达成，在棋盘点击锁定生产器启用。

tutorial.text: 走进新街区之前，先把脚下这一步走稳。
细节决定买手会不会把订单翻到下一页。
tutorial.unlockHint: 皮具配饰台条件达成，在棋盘点击锁定生产器启用。

tutorial.text: 别给我讲品牌故事，让你的第一套街区造型自己说。

orderRules.delivery: consume matching production inventory only; atomically validate and consume all requirements, then grant rewards once by order id
orderRules.estimatedEnergy: For each producer: max(unfilled primary base units / expected primary units per energy, unfilled secondary base units / expected secondary units per energy); sum across producer families. Inventory allocator cannot split higher tiers without an explicit tool.
guards: exclude inactive family until it can be recalled
reserve enough charges for fast order or provide recovery path
reroll only not-yet-completed orders without consuming stock

rewardDraft.storyProgress: chapter objective per specified delivered order; idle bank cannot supply it

orderRules.longTerm: max-tier auto-buy or special commission; never a mandatory early story gate

sideChainPity.meaning: after 12 primary results, next eligible tap yields secondary; resets per producer family
sideChainPity.origin: our demo protection, not a verified original rule

tools.name: 拆分剪刀
tools.effect: one non-producer item level2+ becomes two previous-level items; require a spare tile; cannot split borrowed or special story items

tools.name: 灵感升级卡
tools.effect: one production item gains one level; ordinary items up to level11 only; cannot upgrade producers or max-tier items

tools.name: 充能沙漏
tools.effect: subtract a fixed amount of producer recovery time; no energy generation

tools.name: 体力礼盒
tools.effect: finite chapter or daily grants; claim atomically with unique reward id

effects.drop: producer compression, output flight to nearest empty tile, one sound per tap
effects.merge: source follows finger, valid-target outline, brief squash/pop and tier spark, no whole-board displacement
effects.delivery: reserve requirements, play item flight, grant rewards after atomic commit, input disabled only for the current order

bubbles.definition: optional copy for visible voucher price, can dismiss; no real payment in demo

art.extraAssets: customer portraits, blockers, energy and tool chains; not counted in 203 base icons
art.wardrobeLayers: Separate authored assets aligned to base model; 140 icons do not imply 140 wearable parts.

migration.oldMaterials: legacy tray, freely exchange with visible preview at preserved old economic value; no silent category remap
migration.oldOrders: finish in legacy mode or cancel/refund before starting new order queue

rollout.scope: new board, producers, unit item schema, 3 direct-delivery orders; 2 families, first8 tutorial orders
all7 families /14 chains, weighted drops, cooldowns, inventory, tools, order budgets and guards
chapter milestones, mall upgrades, authored wardrobe rewards, story and full balance tests
